headline: Jorge Messi, father and agent of Lionel Messi, has died at 68
summary: The childhood club of the eight-time Ballon d'Or winner, Newell's Old Boys, announced the passing of the man who guided his entire career.
details: Jorge Messi passed away on Friday in a hospital in Rosario, Argentina, according to reports from Argentinian media.
Newell's Old Boys, Lionel Messi's childhood club, announced the news on Saturday, praising his 'constant companionship and behind-the-scenes leadership' as essential to Lionel's success.
A former metal factory worker, Jorge was his son's first coach and his sole companion when the 13-year-old Messi moved to Spain to join Barcelona in 2000.
He left behind a stable job, his wife, and three other children to ensure his son's career could flourish in Europe.
Jorge served as Lionel's sole representative and agent throughout his tenure at Barcelona, Paris Saint-Germain, and Inter Miami.
The Spanish Football Federation (RFEF) expressed their condolences, conveying love and affection to the Messi family during this time of sorrow.
Lionel Messi once described his father as a critical mentor who pushed him to always strive for more, acknowledging the enormous help he provided.

Beyond his footballing success, Jorge and Lionel faced legal challenges in Spain between 2007 and 2009 regarding tax evasion and image rights, which were resolved in 2017 with multi-million-euro fines.
caption:
The man who guided Lionel Messi's rise to greatness has passed away.

Jorge Messi passed away on Friday in a hospital in Rosario, Argentina, according to reports from Argentinian media.

Newell's Old Boys, Lionel Messi's childhood club, announced the news on Saturday, praising his 'constant companionship and behind-the-scenes leadership' as essential to Lionel's success.

A former metal factory worker, Jorge was his son's first coach and his sole companion when the 13-year-old Messi moved to Spain to join Barcelona in 2000.

He left behind a stable job, his wife, and three other children to ensure his son's career could flourish in Europe.

Jorge served as Lionel's sole representative and agent throughout his tenure at Barcelona, Paris Saint-Germain, and Inter Miami.

The Spanish Football Federation (RFEF) expressed their condolences, conveying love and affection to the Messi family during this time of sorrow.

Lionel Messi once described his father as a critical mentor who pushed him to always strive for more, acknowledging the enormous help he provided.

Beyond his footballing success, Jorge and Lionel faced legal challenges in Spain between 2007 and 2009 regarding tax evasion and image rights, which were resolved in 2017 with multi-million-euro fines.
